entities.name: Abdullah bin Mosaad bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdullah bin Mosaad bin Abdul Aziz Al Saud is the son of Prince Mosaad bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and grandson of King Abdulaziz. He was general president of Saudi Arabia's General Sports Authority from 2014 to 2017.
